run_wrd_to_ltr: run the python script to convert word-level text to letter-level representation via stdin
run_main: run the main function to transform each input line into spaced characters with pipe delimiters
test_main: test the main function by piping text to stdin and verifying character-level output
review_main: review the main function that converts words to letter sequences for wav2vec unsupervised training
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support configurable delimiter instead of hardcoded pipe character
